i: Winds round the neck of the fibula, where it divides into the superficial and deep fibular nerves. Supplies the short head of biceps femoris.

nerves.n: Common plantar digital branches of lateral plantar nerve
i: The calf muscles, the deep flexors of the leg and, through the plantar nerves, the muscles of the sole. Skin of the heel and sole.
Tibialis anterior and the long and short toe extensors. Skin of the first web space.

nerves.n: Dorsal digital branches of deep fibular nerve
i: Tibialis anterior and the toe extensors; skin of the first web space.

nerves.n: Dorsal digital branches of superficial fibular nerve
i: Skin of the dorsum of the foot and toes, except the first web space.

nerves.n: Intermediate dorsal cutaneous nerve of foot
i: Skin of the dorsum of the foot and toes, except the first web space.
The calf muscles, the deep flexors of the leg and, through the plantar nerves, the muscles of the sole. Skin of the heel and sole.

nerves.n: Medial dorsal cutaneous nerve of foot
i: Skin of the dorsum of the foot and toes, except the first web space.
The calf muscles, the deep flexors of the leg and, through the plantar nerves, the muscles of the sole. Skin of the heel and sole.
The two contributions that join to form the sural nerve.

nerves.n: Muscular branches of deep fibular nerve
i: Tibialis anterior and the toe extensors; skin of the first web space.
Quadratus femoris and inferior gemellus; a branch to the hip joint.
Skin of the back of the thigh and upper calf, and of the lower buttock.

nerves.n: Proper plantar digital branches of lateral plantar nerve
i: The calf muscles, the deep flexors of the leg and, through the plantar nerves, the muscles of the sole. Skin of the heel and sole.

nerves.n: Proper plantar digital branches of medial plantar nerve
i: The calf muscles, the deep flexors of the leg and, through the plantar nerves, the muscles of the sole. Skin of the heel and sole.
The hamstrings and the hamstring part of adductor magnus, then every muscle below the knee through its tibial and common fibular divisions.
The perineum and the external anal and urethral sphincters.
Fibularis longus and brevis. Skin of the lower lateral leg and most of the dorsum of the foot.
Gluteus medius, gluteus minimus and tensor fasciae latae.

nerves.n: Sural communicating branch of common fibular nerve
i: The two contributions that join to form the sural nerve.
Skin of the lateral ankle and the lateral border of the foot. Sensory only.
The calf muscles, the deep flexors of the leg and, through the plantar nerves, the muscles of the sole. Skin of the heel and sole.

note: First view: the named nerves of the right sacral plexus. The lumbosacral trunk, the sacral anterior rami and the inferior gluteal nerve are not in the source model and are still to be drawn.
